english.title: Cause use of a vehicle with a front projection exceeding 3.05 metres

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[carrying a load,]_
(B)_[fitted with a special appliance or apparatus,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY LOAD OR APPARATUS..), which had a forward projection exceeding 3.05 metres, when the conditions in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of schedule 12 to the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 had not been complied with in that **(..SPECIFY NON- COMPLIANCE..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(7) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use on a road of a vehicle
carrying a load fitted with a special appliance/apparatus
forward projection exceeded 3.05m condition(s) not complied with

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 82(7) does not apply to straddle carriers.
(ii) The offence wording may be adapted when only one or two of the relevant paragraphs of schedule 12 have been breached.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3339 and H3350.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
